Akira Egawa’sGrand Canvases

Akira Egawa brings epic high-fantasy storytelling to Pokémon cards through rich oil textures, dynamic chiaroscuro lighting, and cinematic scale. Famous for the legendary Crown Zenith Gold VSTAR quartet and Mewtwo V-UNION, each canvas captures Pokémon with mythological reverence and sweeping drama.
